revision: 1. Visual Metaphor Integration: Replace the abstract neon zig-zag with a stylized, glowing trail of fire or smoke that traces the silhouette of a mountain ridge. The 'spark' must serve as the visual origin point, connecting the headline to the landscape to satisfy the 'forested mountain' requirement while retaining the high-contrast energy of the original line. 2. Diagonal Composition & Balance: Anchor the headline 'ONE SPARK IS ENOUGH' in the upper-left. Reposition the secondary text ('Check conditions...') and footer to the bottom-right corner. This creates a dynamic diagonal counter-weight, guiding the viewer's eye along the fire trail from top-left to bottom-right, eliminating the cluttered 'dead zone' and utilizing negative space intentionally. 3. Typographic Hierarchy & Legibility: Ensure the secondary text is placed against the dark mountain silhouette or deep background to guarantee high contrast. Increase the font weight of the secondary text to Bold/Black so it stands up to the glowing graphic without being consumed, treating type as a structural element rather than a passive label. 4. Atmospheric Craft: Replace the flat blue-grey background with a dark, textured gradient (using SVG filters) to simulate smoke or charred timber, grounding the image in an organic, urgent reality. Refine the fire line to use a multi-layered gradient (white core to deep red edge) instead of a uniform neon glow, creating realistic heat intensity and depth.
protected_strengths: The high-contrast color palette (glowing orange against deep navy/dark tones) which ensures immediate visual impact.
The strong, legible headline 'ONE SPARK IS ENOUGH' which effectively anchors the composition.
The conceptual strength of using a linear vector (spark/fire trail) to represent the path of destruction.
resolved_conflicts: Conflict: Abstract tech-style zig-zag vs. Requirement for forest/mountain imagery. Resolution: Transform the zig-zag into a fire/smoke trail tracing a mountain silhouette, merging the dynamic line energy with the required environmental context.

Conflict: Cluttered lower-left text placement vs. Need for clear visual path. Resolution: Move secondary text to bottom-right to create a balanced diagonal composition, preventing text from being 'trampled' by the graphic and establishing a clear visual flow.

Conflict: Sterile digital aesthetic vs. Urgent organic atmosphere. Resolution: Introduce SVG texture filters for smoke/char and multi-layered gradients for the fire, replacing flat colors and uniform glows with realistic depth and heat intensity.
rationale: This brief prioritizes the integration of the visual metaphor (fire trail) with the compositional structure (diagonal balance). It resolves the conflict between the abstract original design and the specific content requirements by evolving the existing strong element (the line) rather than discarding it. It ensures typographic legibility through spatial separation and weight adjustment, while elevating the craft through atmospheric texturing to meet the 'urgent but not chaotic' mandate.
